reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Assemble deterministic build, behavior, performance, accessibility, and brief-conformance evidence into a short verdict packet while reserving play quality and final acceptance for an identified human judge.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare a compact evidence packet for a human game verdict
separate machine-checkable release gates from human judgments of fun and feel
inputs: current build, declared brief, probe results, target devices, and human playtest observations
operations: run hard checks, summarize measured behavior and uncertainty, expose uncovered areas, and request a human verdict
outputs: traceable verdict packet with hard-gate results, measured observations, unknowns, and human decision fields
failureBehavior: withhold completion when evidence is stale, hard gates fail, or no human judgment exists
exclusions: reasoning offered in place of run evidence
silent acceptance of failed hard gates
materialRisks: a concise packet can omit important context
human verdict quality depends on representative play conditions

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Create trustworthy gameplay probes by checking build freshness, executable reachability, causal measurements, variance, portability, and traceability rather than inferring behavior from declarations or source review.
neutralIntentExamples: design probes that prove game systems are reachable and active
measure emergent gameplay with fresh builds, repeated runs, and traceable numbers
inputs: game claims, build artifact, source state, probe harness, and representative scenarios
operations: audit reachability, verify freshness, distinguish stale code from stale probes, repeat variable runs, and measure causal counters
outputs: reproducible probe records with run identity, distributions, coverage limits, and claim linkage
failureBehavior: reject stale or unreachable measurements and keep judged dimensions observe-only until human review
usefulInvariants: every claim maps to a run and number
probe failures identify which contract side may be stale
materialRisks: probe instrumentation can itself be defective
headless behavior may differ from player-visible behavior

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Outline a mobile packaging and store-readiness path spanning identifiers, signing material, attribution, privacy declarations, ratings, listings, device tests, and platform-specific submission constraints.
neutralIntentExamples: prepare a web game for mobile packaging and store submission
audit signing, attribution, privacy, rating, and listing readiness before upload
inputs: built game, target platform, package identity, dependencies, data practices, content, and store account state
operations: inventory submission requirements, preserve signing continuity, generate notices, reconcile disclosures, and test representative devices
outputs: store-readiness checklist and unresolved external authority decisions
failureBehavior: defer installation, signing, upload, listing mutation, and policy conclusions until explicitly authorized and checked against current official sources
exclusions: static legal or policy claims treated as current
usefulInvariants: signing secrets never enter source control
materialRisks: signing and account actions are consequential
license guidance in the source is overbroad

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Specify one narrowly scoped terminal arcade demonstration with fixed controls, presentation details, dependency constraints, and a split between headless logic checks and human interactive testing.
neutralIntentExamples: build a small terminal snake demonstration
separate pure game-logic checks from interactive terminal acceptance
inputs: target output path and terminal capabilities
operations: implement a fixed snake ruleset, terminal rendering, input, score progression, effects, and smoke checks
outputs: single terminal game file and a manual play command
failureBehavior: fall back when color is unavailable and require a human TTY test for interactive behavior
usefulInvariants: logic remains importable without seizing the terminal
materialRisks: prescribed tooling and output paths are not portable

reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Prefer exact version-matched first-party engine references over remembered APIs, while separating framework mechanics from higher-level game-design judgment.
neutralIntentExamples: locate authoritative engine subsystem references before coding
separate framework API guidance from game design and player-experience decisions
inputs: selected engine, installed version, subsystem, and local reference availability
operations: locate relevant first-party references, verify version alignment, and route implementation questions to the narrow subsystem evidence
outputs: bounded engine-reference handoff with version and availability uncertainty
failureBehavior: do not guess changing APIs; defer installation or global instruction changes without authority
exclusions: treating API documentation as evidence of game quality
usefulInvariants: design authority stays outside API references
materialRisks: claimed bundled skill locations can change
install and profile edits mutate project state
